title: Implement the portable command lifecycle foundation
description: Implement the first isolated foundation for stories plx-287b0f and plx-04e73b: a provider-neutral command envelope, transport and lifecycle interfaces, deterministic lease model, worker orchestration core, and in-memory adapters with executable specifications. Do not integrate AWS, modify the existing Celery path, or deploy infrastructure in this task.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation started on feature/portable-command-worker-runtime. The first slice is restricted to executable lifecycle specifications, a provider-neutral core, and in-memory test adapters. AWS integration, infrastructure, existing Celery modules, dashboard behavior, dependencies, and deployment files are explicitly out of scope.
